title: Fix XComs e2e filter tests: scope the filter input by testid (#72438)
body:
Backport of #72438 to `v3-3-test`.

The XComs e2e filter tests located the active filter pill's input via `page.locator("div").filter({ hasText: \`${filterName}:\` }).first()`, which matches an ancestor wrapping the whole table; `getByRole("textbox")` on it then resolved to every XCom-value Monaco editor and failed with "resolved to N elements instead of 1". This gives the actively-editing pill's input a stable `data-testid="filter-pill-input"` and targets it directly.

The original PR's `FilterBar.test.tsx` change is omitted — that unit-test file does not exist on `v3-3-test`, so this backport carries only the e2e fix (component testid + page object).

(cherry picked from commit 0f7f45f674cbd2575c365107f843d2872980760f)
